notes.title: Patch v.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34823527/f44a9a5f1fcf42200f41e3e1679e0c27148f4b3c.jpg[/img]
Hello there!

Here are some changes:

- Tutorial was removed. You still can find all hints in ‘Help’.
- Campaign is fully available now. 
- A new map was added.
- User interface was fixed and improved.
- AI logic was improved.
- Factions became more balanced.
- Big Tower bug was fixed (before if you rotate a tower with mouse wheel, lower gun was aiming incorrectly)

Thank you!
Enjoy the game.

notes.title: The Third Update
notes.notes:
Hello there!

The update includes:

- Tutorial fix
- Help menu improvements (now it contains "aircraft control" and "construct buildings")
- Enemy AI logic improvements (better researching, better tactics)
- Now you can switch timer off in Custom Match
- Balance of researches (some prices were reduced)
- Engineer's logic was fixed. Now he moves to construct a building without a special order (if you build close enough to this engineer)
- One more map was added (more difficult)

Thank you! Enjoy Discharge :)

notes.title: The First Update
notes.notes:
Hello there!

The first update is coming. Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Campaign (5/10 missions for now)
[*] Achievements
[*] Improvement of strategy camera
[*] Tooltips on Researches menu
[*] Map list on a custom match menu
[*] Gameplay interface fixes
[*] Unit's and building's explosions on a destruction were fixed
[*] Direct control statistics after a match (shows KDA and time of playing in 3rd person mode)
[*] Now "Help" is on the main menu too 
[/list]

Thank you for supporting us with feedback. We work hard to make Discharge better for you.

Now we are going to polish Campaign, Help menu and other controls/interfaces to make game easier to understand. Also, we keep monitoring your feedback to react fast.

Thank you! Enjoy Discharge :)
